review_candidates.title: Bid Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Bid Manager to lead the end-to-end bid and proposal management lifecycle while supporting sales teams in developing competitive, commercially viable, and high-quality proposals. The role will work closely with Sales, Presales, Technical, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Operations, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, develop bid strategies, manage pricing and commercial models, and ensure timely and compliant submissions. The Bid Manager will also contribute to sales enablement, performance analysis, process improvement, and the adoption of technology and automation to improve sales and bidding effectiveness. Essential Job Functions Bid & Proposal Management Lead the end-to-end bid management process, from opportunity qualification and bid/no-bid assessment through proposal development, submission, negotiation, and handover. Review and analyze RFPs, RFQs, tenders, and customer requirements, identifying technical, commercial, contractual, and compliance requirements. Develop bid strategies, bid plans, compliance matrices, submission checklists, and timelines. Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure all technical, commercial, financial, and contractual inputs are delivered accurately and on time. Manage the preparation, consolidation, and quality review of technical and commercial proposals. Ensure bids comply with customer requirements, internal governance, approval processes, and applicable policies. Coordinate responses to customer clarifications, amendments, and additional requirements throughout the bid lifecycle. Support commercial and contractual negotiations related to pricing, scope, delivery, payment terms, and other commercial conditions. Pricing & Commercial Management Develop and validate pricing models, cost structures, P&L scenarios, profitability analysis, and risk assessments. Evaluate direct and indirect project costs, including logistics, transportation, installation, training, warranty, customs, financing, and other applicable costs. Work closely with Sales and Finance teams to establish competitive pricing and target margins. Identify commercial risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies. Support internal pricing and commercial approvals in accordance with the company's Delegation of Authority (DoA/LoA) requirements. Analyze market and competitor information to support pricing and bid strategy decisions. Sales Enablement & Business Support Support the development and execution of sales enablement initiatives aligned with business and sales objectives. Partner with Sales leaders to identify opportunities for improving the bid and sales process. Support the development of sales and bid-related training materials, tools, templates, and best practices. Provide Sales teams with guidance on bid strategy, proposal requirements, pricing approaches, and submission processes. Analyze sales, bid, pipeline, and win/loss data to identify trends, improvement opportunities, and potential process gaps. Prepare regular management reports covering bid pipeline, submissions, win rates, profitability, pricing, and overall bid performance. Monitor the effectiveness of sales and bid enablement initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Technology, Automation & Process Improvement Support the selection, implementation, and adoption of bid management, CRM, CPQ, ERP, and sales enablement technologies. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive bidding, pricing, reporting, and data-management activities. Work with relevant teams to improve bid processes through digitalization, automation, data analytics, and standardized tools. Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical reports to support data-driven decision-making. Continuously identify opportunities to improve bid cycle time, pricing accuracy, proposal quality, and overall sales effectiveness. Stakeholder & Team Management Collaborate effectively with Sales, Presales, Technical, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Operations, and senior leadership. Orchestrate multiple stakeholders and ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely delivery of bid inputs. Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, partners, and vendors. May provide guidance and support to junior Bid/Proposal professionals or manage a small team, depending on business requirements. Escalate critical commercial, technical, contractual, or pricing issues to the appropriate management level. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, Science, Information Technology, or another relevant field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Typically, 6+ years of relevant professional experience, with at least 2+ years in Bid Management, Tender Management, Proposal Management, Commercial Management, Pricing, Sales, or a similar role. Proven experience managing complex bids, tenders, RFPs, and commercial proposals. Strong understanding of bid strategy, pricing, commercial analysis, and proposal development. Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong experience in stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and project coordination. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple bids and priorities under tight deadlines. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Excellent command of English and Arabic, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Technology, ICT, Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering, Infrastructure, MedTech, or other technical industries. Experience with Sales Enablement, Sales Operations, Presales, or Commercial Operations. Experience with CRM, CPQ, ERP, Bid Management, or Sales Enablement platforms. Experience with data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar technologies. Experience in process automation, digital transformation, or data-driven decision-making. APMP, CSP, CSEP, or other relevant professional certifications are a plus. Experience managing high-value, multi-country, or multi-stakeholder bids is highly desirable. Advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI Marketplace and Analytics to join Procore’s Agentic Platform team. In this role, you’ll own Toolshed, where anyone at Procore can find, share, and reuse the AI skills, plugins, and connectors that power agentic work, along with the analytics and data products behind it, encompassing the contributor community, telemetry, data streaming, and data visualization. The primary goal of this role is to make Toolshed the first place people at Procore go for AI and to measure the impact AI is having on how work gets done, moving beyond who uses what toward whether work gets faster and better as a result. As a Senior Product Manager, AI Marketplace and Analytics , you’ll partner with engineering peers, data engineering, product leaders, and executive leadership to shape the catalog of AI components, define telemetry strategies, and build reliable data pipelines. Use your platform product management skills, data analytics expertise, and visualization judgment to build a destination people rely on and analytics people return to on their own, with experiences that pull people toward doing more rather than reporting on what they failed to do. You’ll own Toolshed end to end and have a real hand in shaping Procore’s AI journey. Apply today! This position reports into Group Product Manager and will be based in Cairo, Egypt office , with engineering peers and leadership on the same team and direct exposure to the executive driving the initiative. The role starts by owning Toolshed and the measurement of Procore’s agentic tooling, and grows into owning the measurement strategy for Procore’s broader technology transformation. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. What you’ll do: AI is central to how we work. You’ll be expected to master generative tools and agentic workflows, moving beyond just using AI to actively building the agentic future of construction. Own Toolshed and its analytics as products end to end by managing the roadmap, prioritization, and quality across the catalog, community, and measurement surfaces, and by deciding how to balance investment between building Toolshed and measuring its impact. Define where Toolshed expands next to become the single front door for AI at Procore, from listing every AI tool available to building the content and learning resources that take people from first use to everyday use. Shape the catalog and distribution model so skills, plugins, and connectors are easy to discover, trusted, and simple to use in daily workflows. Grow a contributor community by making it easy for teams across the company, including those outside engineering, to publish their work and build on each other’s. Define what gets measured across Procore’s agentic tooling, leading with impact on cycle time, throughput, and quality of work, treating adoption as one input rather than the headline, and ensuring the numbers are reliable enough to make decisions. Run analytics as a product with real users, a roadmap, and retention goals, building visualization layers for every organizational level that highlight visible progress, streaks, and benchmarks, while arguing against metrics that would invite gaming or distort behavior. Make product decisions for pipeline and warehouse architecture by partnering with data engineering on streaming tradeoffs, data modeling, retention, and access security. Work hands-on by prototyping, writing, and building with AI agents daily, as one of the company’s most sophisticated AI-tool users. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or business field, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of experience in product roles focusing on technical, data, or platform products. Experience with platform and community products, such as internal developer portals like Backstage, community hubs like Hugging Face, extension marketplaces, or package registries, or with analytics and data products, including defining, shipping, and rapidly adjusting event taxonomies, ideally with some of both. Strong judgment about data visualization, including when a number needs context, when a chart misleads, and what brings someone back to a dashboard. High measurement literacy, including familiarity with developer productivity metrics such as DORA and an understanding of how metrics influence behavior and get gamed. Daily fluency with AI tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, alongside a working understanding of how agents are extended through skills, plugins, and MCP servers. A track record of driving adoption among people who didn’t have to use what you built. A high bar for quality and craft, rigorous ownership of data, sound judgment when weighing investments, and comfort with ambiguity and messy data in a fast-moving environment. Experience running a catalog, registry, or marketplace with review and governance for shared components. Nice to have. Experience with BI tooling or building custom visualization front ends. Nice to have. Experience with engagement mechanics in a non-consumer setting. Nice to have. Exposure to LLM observability, usage and cost instrumentation, or agent quality assessment. Nice to have.
